title: Thickness-Bounded 12-Layer Search (352-448 nm)
scientific_hypothesis: Constraining thickness perturbations to ±12% of 400 nm (352-448 nm range) prevents optimizer from accessing extreme thickness domains (>520 nm, <290 nm) that caused score regression in iteration_05, while preserving sufficient degrees of freedom for spectral contrast optimization.
design_principle: Bounded perturbation optimization maintains search stability by restricting thickness variables to a narrow band around quarter-wave initialization, preventing destructive interference pattern collapse.
proposed_topology: Air | [HfO2/SiO2]_6 | Si substrate (12 finite layers, alternating sequence fixed)
design_variables: layer thicknesses (352-448 nm bounds per layer)
manufacturing_considerations: thickness bounds compatible with deposition uniformity
theory_basis: Transfer Matrix Method for multilayer interference
Kirchhoff's law relating absorptance to emissivity
expected_advantages: Prevents optimizer divergence to extreme thickness values
Maintains search stability while exploring non-uniform sequences
known_risks: May limit discovery of optimal thick-layer configurations
Narrow bounds could trap optimizer in local minimum
execution_request_english: Optimize a 12-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack on Si substrate with air incidence. Initialize all layers at 400 nm thickness. Apply bounded perturbation optimization with thickness limits 352-448 nm per layer. Evaluate absorptance/emissivity at normal incidence across 3000-5000 nm (suppression band) and 8000-13000 nm (emission band). Use gradient-based optimizer with early stopping if best_target_score improvement <1e-3 for 2 consecutive rounds. Report thicknesses_nm, best_target_score, valid_candidates, tightest_margin, and run_status. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 3000-5000 nm, 8000-13000 nm. soft objectives: high emissivity in 8000-13000 nm; low emissivity in 3000-5000 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high emissivity in 3000-5000 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count not exceeding 24.
revision_reason: Direct response to feedback directive: constrain thickness search to ±12% of 400 nm to prevent access to >520 nm and <290 nm domains that triggered score drop in iteration_05
